tag.label: Tag
tag.hint: Node name: rules and other nodes refer to the node by it

link.label: Paste a link
link.hint: Server link from your provider's app or email: the node is built from it, and the name comes from the link

manual: or choose a type by hand

description.anytls: AnyTLS: proxy over TLS that hides packet sizes
description.call: Tunnel through video calls: VK, Dion, Telemost
description.http: HTTP proxy, with or without TLS
description.masque: MASQUE: Cloudflare proxy over QUIC or HTTP/2
description.mieru: Mieru: a protocol that is hard to recognize
description.naive: NaiveProxy: traffic looks like the Chrome browser
description.parser: Node from a link that sing-box parses itself at startup
description.shadowsocks: Shadowsocks: encrypted proxy with a password
description.shadowtls: ShadowTLS: poses as the TLS handshake of another site
description.sudoku: Sudoku: disguises traffic as random noise
description.trojan: Trojan: proxy that looks like ordinary HTTPS
description.trusttunnel: TrustTunnel by AdGuard: VPN indistinguishable from HTTPS
description.vless: VLESS: lightweight proxy, usually with Reality or TLS
description.selector: The node is chosen by hand from a list
description.urltest: The fastest node by measured delay
description.fallback: The next node by priority when the current one is down
description.failover: Switches nodes and keeps connections alive
description.bridge: Forwards L3 traffic straight out of a network interface

inboundDescription.tun: Virtual network interface: takes the traffic of the whole router or its devices
inboundDescription.mixed: One port for SOCKS4, SOCKS5 and HTTP proxy clients
inboundDescription.redirect: Takes TCP connections the firewall redirects to sing-box
inboundDescription.tproxy: Takes TCP and UDP traffic the firewall passes on transparently
inboundDescription.call: Server for the tunnel through video calls
inboundDescription.http: HTTP proxy server, with or without TLS
inboundDescription.shadowsocks: Shadowsocks server, single user or several
inboundDescription.shadowtls: ShadowTLS server: poses as another site's TLS handshake
inboundDescription.trojan: Trojan server that looks like ordinary HTTPS
inboundDescription.vless: VLESS server, usually with Reality or TLS
inboundDescription.bond: Receiving end of the bond outbound: several links into one
inboundDescription.cloudflared: Cloudflare Tunnel client: exposes the router's services through Cloudflare
inboundDescription.direct: Tunnel server: forwards a port to a fixed address
inboundDescription.failover: Receiving end of the failover outbound

unbuilt.badge: not available in this sing-box build
unbuilt.hint: sing-box on the device is built without this type ({{tag}}): the node is saved, but the check rejects a config with it

error.tagTaken: Another node already uses this tag

link.scheme: Link not recognized: vless://, vmess://, trojan://, ss:// and hysteria2:// are supported
link.malformed: The link is damaged, copy it again in full
link.server: The link has no server address or port
link.credential: The link has no access key: UUID or password
link.transport: sing-box does not support the transport from the link
